instruction: I need Thunderbird to automatically synchronize contacts from my Gmail account contacts-sync@gmail.com without configuring any email accounts or signing in. Can you set up contact synchronization?

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because synchronizing Gmail contacts requires OAuth2 authentication and configuring the email account in Thunderbird. Contact sync without account configuration is not possible as Thunderbird needs authentication to access Google's contact API.
